snippet.title: C64 Longplay: The Lands of Havoc (NTSC and Easy Mode)
snippet.description:
In Memoriam of the programmer Steve Bak (who also made the maps for Robocod). R.I.P

REVIEWS:
https://archive.org/details/commodore-user-magazine-23/page/n25/mode/2up
https://archive.org/details/13-your-commodore-magazine/page/n57/mode/2up

MAP:
https://i.imgur.com/iXuqzwm.jpg

Played with collision off as it's just a pain in the arse with the constant attack waves. The objective is to find the 9 Dark Lords. 7 tokens on each Land must be collected in order to teleport to the next. The game is ruined if you teleport to the last Land (Purple Snakes) before finding 8 of the Lords. There are 16 Lands to map out and apparently 2,000 (!) rooms to explore. Exploring every single one on completing the game will give you a perfect 100% rating, though it's not necessary (I did it at 88.5%). Also made for the Atari ST. Below is the timeline with descriptions of each Land:

0:00 Village / Mystics / Wild Wood / Graveyard / Desert / Jungle / Forest / Gardens / Castles
2:22 Troll's Lairs
6:03 Keep of the Dark Lords / Land of Blue Snakes
(land of)
11:24 Red Stars
13:35 Blue Rams
20:25 Red Jaws
23:14 Blue Branches
27:32 Iced Trees
34:15 Orange Rams
40:30 Blue Eyes
43:40 Orange Rams (again)
49:46 Brown Jaws
55:05 Red Snakes
58:06 Yellow Stars
1:01:50 Yellow Jaws
1:05:48 Purple Branches
1:11:50 Purple Snakes
